exceptions.why: The shipped default model source (https://cdn.aiofourown.com/models/), written into window.APP_CONFIG from app-config.json. It is disclosed in docs/DATA-HANDLING.md and the model-source notice and changeable by one setting (config/app-config.json), so it is a permanent exception with no until.
The same default model source: disclosed (docs/DATA-HANDLING.md, the model-source notice) and replaceable by one setting (config/app-config.json).
The project's own repository, where releases and bug reports are published (the maintainer's account is part of its address, shown as a link or as the link's text).
The licence notice that goes with the voice worker names the project's repository, where the complete corresponding source of the voice worker is offered (a licence requirement).

The injection point of the site layer: the link is built only from site.supportEmail, which a neutral build does not have, so no address is shown. It is code that decides how to build a link, not a contact address of ours.

Code comments that say where a character package or a preset handoff comes from: Cosmogenitor is a technical input, the producer of the packages this copy can read. No string shown to a person names it: where the app shows a picture's author it prints the package's own author field from the data, never as a recommendation, a promotion or a link.
A notice that names the vendored component authored-profiles and its registry package, with its licence; a licence-required statement, not text about the app.
The vendored component's own identifiers (package ids and format names, read-only, pinned in vendor.lock.json); not text a person reads.

A vendored library's built-in fallback address. Not reached by the code: the app always gives the wasm location itself (chat/embedding/embedder.mjs; runtime/providers/adapters/wllama.mjs). A request log that proves it is still to be added (board T740), so this is not yet proven.
The vendored WebLLM library's own text names a social site; it is third-party library text and no link is shown by the app.
The application's own mark (layer A): it shares a generic file name with the family's packet assets, but its hash differs from every packet asset.
The shipped default model source, listed so that fetch-models can fetch the files from it (docs/APP-CONFIG.md); the same disclosed, replaceable default as in index.html.
The same default model source, listed so that fetch-models can fetch the files from it.
The data handling document must say who serves the shipped default model source, because an operator has to know it (docs/DATA-HANDLING.md, section 2).
The data handling document names the shipped default model source host; it says that this host is replaceable by one setting.
The generated table of hosts that the vendored libraries' files name; the document says none of them is contacted by the app (not yet proven by a request log, board T740).
The same generated table: a host a vendored library's own text names, which the app does not contact.

The self-hosting document names, once, the shipped default model source in its 'What it contacts' table, as the template requires, with how to change it by one setting (docs/DATA-HANDLING.md says the same).
The same single mention of the default model source host in the self-hosting document's 'What it contacts' table.
